name: EN 301 549 — Accessibility requirements for ICT products and services
standard: V3.2.1 (2021-03, WCAG 2.1 AA) is the version cited in the OJ; V4.1.1 (2026-09, WCAG 2.2 AA) published but not yet cited

laws.summary: Cites EN 301 549 V3.2.1 as the harmonised standard under the Web Accessibility Directive.

applies_to: Any ICT: web, non-web documents, software including native mobile apps, hardware, two-way communication, documentation and support. Used as the WAD presumption standard, for public procurement, and adopted as CAN/ASC-EN 301 549:2024 in Canada.

deadlines.what: V3.2.1 cited in the OJ (Decision 2021/1339, published 2021-08-12)
V4.1.1 published by ETSI (WCAG 2.2, EAA Annex ZB mapping)

exceptions: Clause 9/10/11 criteria apply only where the ICT has the relevant feature; notes in each clause scope out non-applicable items (e.g. several WCAG criteria are not applied to non-web documents or closed software)
requires: Clause 6: two-way voice (V3.2.1); real-time bidirectional communication (V4.1.1)
Clause 7: ICT with video capabilities (captions, audio description)
Clause 9: web content — WCAG 2.1 A+AA (V3.2.1) / WCAG 2.2 A+AA (V4.1.1)
Clause 10: non-web documents (PDF, office files) — WCAG adapted
Clause 11: software, including native mobile apps (V4.1.1 title: 'Non-web software') — WCAG adapted plus platform/AT interoperability and user preferences
Clause 12: documentation and support services (V4.1.1 title: 'Information about products and services')
Clause 13: relay and emergency service access
Annex ZA: mapping to WAD 2016/2102 (V3.2.1 Annex A); V4.1.1 adds Annex ZB mapping to EAA 2019/882
mobile: explicit — Clause 11 covers software including native mobile apps; Clause 9 covers mobile web.
procurement: Originated as the European procurement standard (Mandate M/376) and still used as the ICT accessibility spec in public tenders.
enforcement: A standard, not law. It gives legal effect as a presumption of conformity when cited in the OJ under WAD (and EAA once cited).
notes: Clause titles were extracted from both ETSI PDFs' tables of contents. WCAG counts in the texts: V3.2.1 refers to 'WCAG 2.1' 423 times; V4.1.1 refers to 'WCAG 2.2' 461 times. The V4.1.1 OJ citation date is provisional in secondary sources (2026-11-30 or 2026-12-16), so re-check it before relying on it.
